body.name: least-favourable survivor-support face envelope
body.construction: Retain \(\mathcal R_n^{\mathrm{ret}}\) at tolerance \(a_n\), evaluate the explicit quotient gradients \(\widehat g^L_{n,r}\) and \(\widehat g^U_{n,r}\), and take their common conditional multiplier maximum; no latent linear program is solved.
